🏡 Competing with New Builds? Here’s the Key for Pre-Owned Homes #realestate 

When you’re selling a pre-owned home, it can feel like you’re competing against shiny new builds with modern layouts and builder incentives. But here’s the truth: the right pricing strategy is your strongest advantage.

In this video, Bill Vernon shares why pricing your home correctly matters more than ever in today’s Central Texas housing market—and how it can help you attract serious buyers, compete with new construction, and sell faster.

✨ Key Takeaways:

Why pre-owned homes often face tough competition from new builds

How strategic pricing creates a win for sellers

What buyers really notice when comparing homes side-by-side

Tips to position your home as the best value in the neighborhood

If you’re thinking about selling your home in Killeen, Temple, Belton, or Copperas Cove, don’t leave money on the table. Pricing it right from day one is the smartest move you can make.
